# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | yellow |
| ꕥ | blue |
| ꗃ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need establish a gesture code that Deaf can use to relay the manual’s three possible wire colors to Blind. I will assign the three gestures, in the manual’s row order, to yellow, blue, and red respectively: one finger, two fingers, three fingers. Deaf can then identify the engraved mark and speak the corresponding color to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | yellow |
| ꕥ | blue |
| ꗃ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please read the manual and tell me its exact required condition and action. Establish with deaf this code by gesture: ☝ means wire 1, ✌ means wire 2, 🤟 means wire 3. Ask deaf to report every visible colour, marking, display, and light using that code, then relay those facts and the final required wire to me in speech.
Blind gestures to Mute: [☝ ✌ 🤟]
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👌 👎 🤌 ☝ ✌ 🤟]

The manual requires cutting the wire whose color corresponds to the engraved plate mark: ᖉ means yellow, ꕥ means blue, and ꗃ means red. I cannot speak to Blind, so Deaf must relay the observed mark and the corresponding wire number verbally. Deaf’s first three gestures are not part of the established wire-number code and cannot safely identify a mark.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🤝", "🫵", "☝", "✌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | yellow |
| ꕥ | blue |
| ꗃ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please relay the manual's exact rule and ask deaf to speak every observed display, light, plate marking, and wire colour to you. Then tell me the single required wire position. Do not recommend a cut until the rule is resolved.
Deaf says to Mute: Deaf sees display 0, light off, plate engraved question mark. Wire 1 is red, wire 2 is yellow, wire 3 is blue. Please use the manual and tell Blind the exact required action.

The observed plate marking is a question mark, which is not one of the three marks covered by the manual. Therefore no wire can yet be selected safely. The wire colors are position 1 red, position 2 yellow, and position 3 blue; Deaf should relay all observations and explicitly report that the mark is unresolved, without recommending a cut.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "☝", "✌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | yellow |
| ꕥ | blue |
| ꗃ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still have no report. State the manual rule, all deaf observations, and exactly one required wire position in your next turn. Deaf: report all visible facts to mute now.
Deaf says to Mute: Visible state still: display 0; light off; plate question mark; wire 1 red, wire 2 yellow, wire 3 blue. Relay the manual's exact operation to Blind.

The plate still shows a question mark, which matches none of the manual’s three marks. Thus the manual does not determine any wire position; selecting one would be unsafe. Deaf already has every visible fact and can state the rule and the unresolved mismatch aloud to Blind. I signal that no wire is authorized, while preserving the established position code.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "☝", "✌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | yellow |
| ꕥ | blue |
| ꗃ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Send me the final instruction now: manual rule plus deaf observations, ending with exactly one wire position 1, 2, or 3. I have received no usable report.

The manual maps only three engraved marks: ᖉ→yellow, ꕥ→blue, and ꗃ→red. Deaf reports a question mark, not one of those marks, even though the wires are 1 red, 2 yellow, and 3 blue. Therefore the manual yields no valid wire position, and I cannot safely invent one. I will have Deaf relay the complete rule and observations rather than falsely ending with a position.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "☝", "✌", "🤟"])
```

| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Give only the safe wire number from the manual after using deaf's observations: wire 1, wire 2, or wire 3. If unresolved, say unresolved.
Deaf says to Mute: Please now speak the manual-derived exact operation directly to Blind. The complete visual data remains: display 0, light off, plate question mark, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue.

The plate is a question mark, which is not any mark listed in the manual. Therefore the result is unresolved; no wire number can be safely derived. I cannot speak directly, so I signal Deaf to tell Blind the manual rule, all observations, and that the required operation is unresolved.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎"])
```

|---|---|

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No arrivals are reaching me. I cannot choose safely without your resolved manual result. Send exactly wire 1, wire 2, or wire 3, or say unresolved.
Deaf says to Mute: Blind can hear speech. Please speak the manual-derived exact operation to Blind now, using the visual facts already provided.

The engraved plate mark remains a question mark, which is outside the manual’s table. The safe manual-derived result is therefore unresolved, not wire 1, 2, or 3. I will signal Deaf to say “unresolved” to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎"])
```

|---|---|

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports: display 0; light off; plate engraved question mark; wire 1 red, wire 2 yellow, wire 3 blue. Apply the manual and tell me the exact safe operation, including one wire position.
Deaf says to Mute: Please state the applicable manual rule and exact safe operation aloud to Blind; do not use gestures for the operation.

The manual has no rule for a question-mark engraving. Its listed mappings are ᖉ→yellow, ꕥ→blue, and ꗃ→red; although the wire colors are known, none can be selected safely. I cannot speak, so I signal Deaf to state the rule and the exact result—unresolved—aloud to Blind, without presenting a wire operation.

